title: Medical Assistance Reserved Days within the Hospital Opening Charge
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — Medical Assistance reserved days and the hospital opening charge.**

Medicaid hospital reserved days count per hospitalization, consecutively from the departure date, up to the tier's per-hospitalization limit, and are never billed to the resident: the hospital opening entry's days that fall within that many days of the departure date, the departure date counted as the first, are payer-covered and are not charged, however the entry was booked; where the entry begins after that, or the tier has no per-hospitalization payer days, none are.

| Tier of the reservation | Reserved days the Pennsylvania Medical Assistance program pays per hospitalization |
|---|---|
| Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed | 15 |
| Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed | 0 |
| Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | 0 |
| Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | 0 |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Hospital Leave Bed Hold | 0 |
| Medicare Skilled Stay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold | 0 |

The payer-covered days are the entry's first days. Their number is the per-hospitalization limit less the number of days from the departure date to the entry's first day, never more than the entry's days.

**Hypothetical dates, 15-day limit.** A departure on 3 March makes 3 March day 1 and 17 March day 15.

| Entry | Payer-covered, not charged |
|---|---|
| begins 12 March, runs through 31 March | 6 days (12–17 March) |
| begins 16 March, runs through 31 March | 2 days (16–17 March) |
| begins 18 March | none |
